title: Degree-one signed shift compatibility of coefficient evaluation
statement: Let H be the recorded derived internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], O the coefficient unit, and M any normalized ringed-site duality model [lem-sfb-ringed-site-duality-maps]. Put T(X)=H(X,O). For every derived object X, the evaluation-transpose bidual map b satisfies b_(X[1]) followed by -(H((sourceShift X 1).hom.op,id_O) followed by (sourceShift (T X) (-1)).inv) = b_X[1]. The source shifts have the complete representative normalization of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-internal-hom-exact-restriction]. This asserts only the degree-one morphism equality, without exactness, coherent integer shifts, triangle morphisms or slice restriction.

source.place: Tags 0A8X, 08JC and 0A97; the signed representative calculation in lem-coef-rational-bidual-triangle-compatibility

proof.text: Resolve the coefficient O by a K-injective I. Define b_E(x)(f)=(-1)^(p*q)f(x) for homogeneous x and f of degrees p and q. Expanding the Hom differential cancels the d_I terms and gives b_E(dx), so b is a natural chain map. The delivered private generalHom_d_eval, generalBidualDegree_comm and generalOrdinaryBidual check this ordinary chain-map construction for arbitrary I, with both target-differential terms retained and canceled; no zero-differential hypothesis is used. The delivered ordinaryBidual_naturality proves functoriality by both Hom-functor projection formulas and the naturality of the input chain map on restricted sections; generalOrdinaryBidualTransformation packages the resulting natural transformation.

source.place: Tags 0A8X, 08J9, 08JC and 0A97; explicit signed Hom-complex calculation

proof.text: Take a K-flat representative P and a K-flat replacement a:L to Hom(P,I). The normalized tensor-Hom adjunction represents evaluation after Koszul symmetry by (x,l) to (-1)^(p*q)a(l)(x). Currying gives Hom(a,I)b_P. Since Hom(a,I) is a quasi-isomorphism, this identifies Q(b_P) with the actual evaluation transpose. Naturality and K-flat replacement identify Q(b_E) with derived evaluation for arbitrary representatives. No assertion that ordinary Hom into O computes arbitrary derived Hom is used.

source.place: Tags 0A8X, 08J9, 08JC and 0A97; explicit signed Hom-complex calculation

proof.text: The normalized signed double-Hom comparison has degree-p, inner-degree-t sign (-1)^(p+t). On b_(E[1]) the combined exponent is p+t+p*(t+1), differing from (p+1)*t by 2*p. Thus the composite is b_E[1]. The fixed source-shift representative normalization and localization give exactly the asserted derived equality. The delivered private ordinaryBidual_shift_one proves the ordinary equality for arbitrary E and I, using the actual chi and its product-projection formula supplied by the proved SignedDoubleHomCone.comparison; unsignedReindex_eval checks the reindexing explicitly. Only representative identification and descent remain in this step.

lean.statement:
theorem coefficientBidualEvaluation_shift_one
    (M : RingedSiteDualityModel.{c, v, r, w} J R) (X : D.{c, v, r, w} J R) :
    let O := ringedSiteDualityUnit.{c, v, r, w} J R
    let H := derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, r, w} J R
    let T := Prod.sectL _ O ⋙ H
    ringedSiteBidual M.closed M.symmetric O (X⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) ≫
        (-(H.map (Prod.mkHom ((sourceShift.{c, v, r, w} J R X 1).hom.app O).op
          (𝟙 O)) ≫ (sourceShift.{c, v, r, w} J R (T.obj (op X)) (-1)).inv.app O)) =
      (ringedSiteBidual M.closed M.symmetric O X)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧'
